summary: Design clearer social protection coverage, benefit and accountability policies using ILO and SDG references. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Social protection policy design turns commitments into coverage, eligibility, benefit and delivery choices. For policy officers, programme designers and development-planning advisers, this course addresses the practical task of building a coherent, reviewable policy package despite data and coordination constraints. Participants map lifecycle coverage gaps, compare eligibility and benefit options, test adequacy and equity scenarios, and assign institutional responsibilities with indicators for policy review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who shape social protection policy, translate commitments into programme rules or advise on how benefits fit across population risks. It suits intermediate-level professionals who need to turn policy choices into reviewable, implementable documents.
modules: ILO Recommendation No. 202 Adequacy and Equity
prerequisites: Intermediate-level familiarity with social protection programmes, policy documents or programme administration is expected. No coding is required; working familiarity with eligibility rules and benefit arrangements will help you contribute to the applied exercises.
